verdict.rationale: Strict typing and schema validation are a fair axis for an agent framework like AutoGen, but the evidence pack never mentions type checking, typed APIs, or schema validation that would let an agent catch its own errors at build time. Declarative JSON specs and component serialization are adjacent features, not validation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on strict typing and schema validation so a coding agent catches its own mistakes at build time
